set.body: Repair the reproduced Glasser hemisphere collision: volume ID 1 can mean R_V1_ROI while surface ID 1 means L_V1_ROI, yet current exact domains align. The user confirmed there are no dependent users to preserve. Independently regenerate the fixed foreign-producer byte fixture for the current keys; no migration API or obsolete key mode. Acceptance: opposite-hemi/renumbered/reordered fixtures demonstrate correct alignment or rejection, malformed/duplicate/missing canonical keys are typed failures, publication restores and assignment source maps remain exact, atlas JVM and JS pass.
